method: Read only the exact repository paths in the two existing manifests; compare SHA-256 of file bytes; check file metadata before/after hashing and again at the end of each manifest scan.
limits: This verifies only the 161 and 240 listed paths. It does not inventory or assert absence of additional unlisted files, excluded dependencies, generated artifacts or user data.
This is a bounded read interval, not an atomic filesystem snapshot; metadata changes during the interval are reported.
Source/prototype identity does not establish installed application identity or complete product acceptance.
No source file was modified and no tests, UI operations or Agent requests were run.
